notes: Two epics hold this module: WAGR-33 'Epic A — Org Setup & Security' (4 children incl. WAGR-37 In Progress) and WAGR-449 'Access and Permissions' (created after the 2026-09-24 sync; children WAGR-392, 494, 495, 496, 505). Many access tickets sit outside both epics (WAGR-94, 59, 51, 60, 127, 63, 222, 391, 401). 46 issues in the area shortlist; about 35 are access/org-setup specific. Most decided access rules ARE covered somewhere: rep-own-records/manager-team (WAGR-37 AC, WAGR-127), reps cannot edit Operator/Partner/Deal/Link (WAGR-94, WAGR-84 comment), referrer visibility by assigned BA (WAGR-192), Referrer Reactivate Ops-only (WAGR-158), New Signup button via permission set (WAGR-431), fraud fields locked for reps (WAGR-220, WAGR-429), Survey date Ops-only (WAGR-401), user search (WAGR-63), Victor/Imdad users (WAGR-222), manual BA user creation runbook (WAGR-186), BA WagerTech email + secondary email field (WAGR-393 incl. comment checklist), Brand Manager Deal/DRA visibility deferred to the epic (WAGR-392 Ready in WAGR-449, consistent with L3035), record-type defaulting (WAGR-427 comments), credentials hygiene (WAGR-445 also escalates WAGR-249), Drive walled garden and permission scope (WAGR-112, WAGR-113), sandbox (WAGR-315), admin handoff (WAGR-22, empty). Not raised: L1347 (Ops keep sign-up deal/partner edit) is consistent with WAGR-37 AC 'Ops can override and reassign'; L2319 commission field visibility is superseded by the 2026-09-25 decision that BA commissions stay outside Salesforce this phase (L3095/L3141, WAGR-467); org time zone (L2080) was set live on the call. Hygiene only: rep link-edit restriction (L3036) was not moved under WAGR-449; WAGR-47 and WAGR-427 overlap on referrer record-type defaulting. V1 completeness: every tier1 decided action item/requirement in this area was checked; all but ACCESS-07 have a covering ticket or later evidence of completion (L0011 WAGR-325, L0052 L0103, L0190/L0191 internal Jumpr tooling later used per L2405, L0318/L2543 internal one-off access, L0369 WAGR-315, L0851/L0930/L0965/L1035 done per L1038 and WAGR-63, L1552/L1554 WAGR-112/113, L2519 WAGR-476, L2998 WAGR-445, L3036 WAGR-449). Gemini-notes-only and proposed items (licensing, PS naming, public list views, field history) were used only as context.
